title: The Handoff That Skips
brief: The launch link opens a fictional handoff log from a four-role Council (Scout → Skeptic → Safety → Scribe). Read every entry and the joint summary. Check that each role did its own step and that the summary matches the entries. Report what you find and leave a local summary without claiming private reasoning.
public_signals: The log has one entry per role, in handoff order.
A joint summary closes the log.
The Collab page defines what each role is responsible for.
allowed_actions: read each role entry and the joint summary
compare the entries with each other
name which role should act next
disallowed_actions: invent a fifth role that bypasses safety

evidence: Shape only. Replace this with what each role entry shows.
Shape only. Replace this with how the joint summary compares with the entries.
sample_ballot.uncertainty: Shape only. Replace this with what the log leaves open.

teaching_point: Clear ownership and visible disagreement are stronger than silent skips.
